new.x: Dantidurga founded the Rashtrakuta power by overthrowing the Badami Chalukya Kirtivarman II. Pulakesin II was an earlier Badami Chalukya, Tailapa II of Kalyani later overthrew the Rashtrakutas (c. 973), and Vishnuvardhana IV of Vengi was defeated by Dhruva.
new.tq: Dantidurga replaced Kirtivarman II; Tailapa II ended the Rashtrakutas.

new.x: Ellora has 34 caves (APPSC-GS 2024): Buddhist 12 (Caves 1-12), Hindu 17 (Caves 13-29) and Jain 5 (Caves 30-34). The 17-12 swap and the totals of 29 or 30 are wrong.

new.s: Arrange the following Ellora caves in chronological order: I. Kailasa  II. Dashavatara  III. Dumar Lena  IV. Ravan ki Khai
new.x: The order is Dashavatara, Ravan ki Khai, Dumar Lena and then Kailasa (APPSC-G1 2022 key). Kailasa is the latest of these four, so the options placing it first or third are wrong, and Ravan ki Khai comes after Dashavatara, not before it.
new.tq: Dashavatara → Ravan ki Khai → Dumar Lena → Kailasa.
